raw_record.original_question: 读某地太阳高度日变化值随日期变化图：<image1>。根据图示，图中③日期太阳直射哪个半球？
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: in the figure, the vertical axis represents “daily variation value of solar altitude”, and the horizontal axis represents date; the left end of the horizontal axis is marked 3.21, and after that ①, ②, ③, ④ appear in sequence. The curve near the position of ③ is on a high-value plateau segment of about 30°, and ③ is obviously after 3.21 and has not yet reached the stage after the curve clearly declines.
Then reason: around March 21, the sun directly shines on the equator; after that, the direct point of the sun enters the Northern Hemisphere and remains in the Northern Hemisphere until the autumnal equinox. In the figure, ③ is located in the high-value stage after 3.21, so on date ③ the sun directly shines on the Northern Hemisphere.
